about_body:
Dr. Abraham Jaskiel owns Brickell Avenue Dentistry, a cosmetic practice in one of Miami's most visible neighborhoods.

The approach pairs cosmetic work with a holistic view of what goes into the mouth and how treatment is delivered. Patients come for a smile that photographs well and stay for care that respects the rest of their health.

services.blurb: Full cosmetic planning for patients who want the whole smile changed, not one tooth.

services.name: Cosmetic dentistry
services.blurb: Treatment chosen for how the result will look in daylight, on camera and up close.

services.name: Holistic dentistry
services.blurb: A materials-conscious approach for patients who want dental care to fit their wider health.

services.name: Invisalign
services.blurb: Clear aligner treatment for adults who want straighter teeth without visible braces.
